Contract RepairService::approve(sid: Integer,rid: Integer,reject: Boolean,suggestion: String): ApprovalHistory {
	definition:
		repair: Repair = Repair.allInstance()->any(r|r.Id = rid),
		staff: Staff = Staff.allInstance()->any(s|s.Id = sid)
	precondition:
		Repair.allInstance()->includes(repair) and
		Staff.allInstance()->includes(staff)
	postcondition:
		let ah: ApprovalHistory in
		ah.oclIsNew() and
		ApprovalHistory.allInstance()->includes(ah) and
		ah.StaffId = sid and
		ah.Reject = reject and
		ah.Suggestion = suggestion and
		repair.History->includes(ah) and
		(reject = true and
		repair.Process = 5 or
		reject = false and
		repair.Process@pre = 0 and
		staff.Role = 1 and
		repair.Process = 1 or
		reject = false and
		repair.Process@pre = 1 and
		staff.Role = 2 and
		repair.Process = 2 or
		reject = false and
		repair.Process@pre = 2 and
		staff.Role = 3 and
		repair.Process = 3) and
		result = ah
}
